methodology.name: independent per-scale pivoted QR comparison
methodology.amplitudeRule: within each scale only, prefer the largest mean absolute candle return among pivots within the residual-equivalence band
methodology.crossScaleRule: compare membership recurrence only; candle-return amplitudes are never averaged across intervals

indexWeighting.name: equal-weight multiscale index of capped liquidity-weighted scale sleeves
indexWeighting.sizeProxy: median daily quote volume within each scale window
